heldReason: The dictionary writes the last two strokes of 兪 as 巜 while the pinned MM candidate writes 刂; a component form the candidate does not share cannot be fixed by local correction, so the glyph fails closed. The Ja corpus keeps the 巜 form (兪 in g2 batch 6).

directionProbe.threshold: angle over 60° between dictionary and candidate start-to-end vectors

subThresholdSlants.note: Short dots the dictionary draws vertically while the licensed corpora slant them, below the inspection threshold. Kept as licensed geometry, as in batches 1 to 10.

sourceTransform.note: serve.py, source-checks.mjs and direction-probe.mjs accept translate(x, -y); the offset does not change stroke directions.
